items.text: Fixed a scale override on the large rig monument blocker that was causing collision problems for players.
Sleepers can now be killed in safezones after a server restart, fixing a regression that let them survive indefinitely.
Resolved issues with frog spawning and behavior, ensuring frogs appear and act correctly in the world.
High‑Quality Metal collectable now shows its proper name token in the UI.
Pipe access fixes prevent trees from spawning inside pipes and improve terrain transitions near pipe networks.
Clan tag text on player nameplates now aligns correctly when auto‑sized, improving readability.
Electrical circuits now update immediately when modified mid‑tick, fixing delayed or missing power changes.
Players can now place water pipes on beach terrain, expanding building options in coastal areas.

2026-08-31.summary:
### World & Monuments
- Fixed a scale override on the large rig monument blocker that was causing collision problems for players.

### NPC & AI
- Sleepers can now be killed in safezones after a server restart, fixing a regression that let them survive indefinitely.
- Resolved issues with frog spawning and behavior, ensuring frogs appear and act correctly in the world.

### Items & Collectibles
- High‑Quality Metal collectable now shows its proper name token in the UI.

### Infrastructure & Pipes
- Pipe access fixes prevent trees from spawning inside pipes and improve terrain transitions near pipe networks.

### UI
- Clan tag text on player nameplates now aligns correctly when auto‑sized, improving readability.

### Gameplay & Balance
- Electrical circuits now update immediately when modified mid‑tick, fixing delayed or missing power changes.
- Players can now place water pipes on beach terrain, expanding building options in coastal areas.

Reduced pipe hole mesh size and adjusted anchor setup to eliminate terrain gaps, preventing unintended openings in structures.

2026-08-30.summary:
### Audio & Communication
- Heavy plate helmets now muffle player voice more strongly (volume reduction lowered from 2400 to 1800).

### Gameplay & Balance
- Reduced pipe hole mesh size and adjusted anchor setup to eliminate terrain gaps, preventing unintended openings in structures.

items.text: Explosive ammo now damages monument blockers as intended.
Crates and barrels on both oil rigs now respawn correctly after being looted.
Siege tower doors function properly and NPCs no longer get stuck when doors slam on them.
Fixed a bug where deployable structures could display random skins, ensuring they keep their intended appearance.

2026-08-29.summary:
### Combat & Weapons
- Explosive ammo now damages monument blockers as intended.

### Monuments & World
- Crates and barrels on both oil rigs now respawn correctly after being looted.

### Siege & Vehicles
- Siege tower doors function properly and NPCs no longer get stuck when doors slam on them.

### Gameplay & Balance
- Fixed a bug where deployable structures could display random skins, ensuring they keep their intended appearance.
